jobs.title: President & COO / Operating Lead
jobs.description:
President & COO / Operating Lead - Dabria Studios

Dabria Studios is a creator-led media studio that develops, produces, owns, and distributes original scripted programming directly to audiences.
Our first original, The Lockdown House , has completed principal photography; dabriastudios.com is live, and we are preparing a four-property 2027 Pilot Season.
We’re looking for a President & COO / Operating Lead
to work directly alongside the founder and build the operating company around our creative slate.
The founder will continue leading creative vision, IP, development, showrunning, and slate strategy. This role will own the systems, planning, financial discipline, and cross-functional execution needed to scale Dabria Studios.
What you’ll own

Day-to-day company operations and operating priorities
Budgeting, cash planning, forecasts, and financial coordination
Fundraising operations, investor follow-up, diligence, and reporting
Company timelines, KPIs, accountability systems, and internal workflows
Coordination across production, commercial, audience/growth, and platform/data functions
Recruiting and managing specialist operators, contractors, and project teams
Vendor and professional-service relationships
Operating preparation for Dabria Studios’ 2027 Pilot Season
Support for sponsorship, partnerships, and commercial planning
New York–Melbourne operating coordination as the company expands production in Australia
Turning founder strategy into clear plans, owners, deadlines, and execution

Who we’re looking for

You may currently be a COO, Head of Operations, VP/Director of Operations, General Manager, Chief of Staff, or senior business-operations leader ready to take on broader ownership.
Strong candidates will have experience in some combination of:
Startup or early-stage company operations
Media, entertainment, digital media, creator economy, or production
Financial and operational planning
Fundraising and investor-facing work
Business development or partnerships
Managing distributed teams and contractors
Building systems from scratch
Working closely with a founder in a fast-moving environment

We’re especially interested in operators who are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
This is not a creative leadership role
. The President & COO will build and run the operating infrastructure around Dabria Studios’ creative slate while working closely with the founder on company strategy.
Role structure

This position will begin as a  part-time/fractional contractor engagement during Dabria Studios’ current pre-seed raise
, with the intention of expanding into a larger paid President & COO role following financing.
The role is remote, and Dabria Studios operates across New York and Melbourne, so comfort working asynchronously across time zones is important.
Compensation

Initial compensation is expected to fall within an annualised equivalent range of $40,000–$60,000
, prorated to the agreed fractional scope and time commitment.
Compensation and scope will be revisited if the role expands following financing.
Equity

No equity is currently being offered with this contractor position. Dabria Studios remains a single-member LLC.
Benefits

Because this begins as an independent contractor engagement, traditional employee benefits are not currently included. If the position later converts to full-time employment, we will revisit compensation and benefits as part of that transition.
Hiring process

Selected candidates can expect:
Introductory conversation with the Founder
Deeper operating/experience interview
Working discussion focused on Dabria Studios’ 2027 operating plan and current fundraising stage
Reference checks for finalist candidates
Final scope and compensation discussion

We’re looking for someone who wants to help build the operating foundation of an independent media company — not simply maintain systems that already exist.
Applicant privacy

We will use applicant information only to evaluate candidates for this role and related hiring purposes. We will not sell or use application materials for unrelated marketing.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Solution Tree seeks a Chief Operating Officer to turn company strategy into coordinated execution across a complex, mission-driven education enterprise. The COO will be the CEO's principal operating partner, aligning leaders, priorities, resources, systems, and accountability so guidance becomes measurable outcomes. This is not a command-and-control role. Success depends on influence, judgment, relationships, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to lead strong functional executives without taking over their work. Think hurdle remover: the focus is execution.

Enterprise Scope

The COO provides enterprise-wide coordination across Solution Tree, Marzano Resources, Solution Tree Canada, Results Coaching Global, state offices, and affiliated growth businesses and initiatives. The role spans publishing, professional development, events, educational technology, author and associate relations, customer operations, fulfillment, facilities, information technology, cybersecurity, state-office operations, coaching services, and enterprise project execution.

Primary Responsibilities

Serve as a trusted strategic and operating adviser to the CEO; translate priorities into clear ownership, decisions, milestones, operating rhythms, and results.
Lead cross-functional execution, resolve barriers and competing priorities, strengthen accountability, and intervene early when revenue, profitability, service, timing, quality, or reputation is at risk.
Support enterprise financial performance through disciplined planning, budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, performance review, and portfolio decisions in partnership with the CEO and CFO.
Protect operational continuity, cybersecurity, technology reliability, customer service, fulfillment, facilities, and business-critical processes; ensure risks have clear owners and practical response plans.
Guide senior leaders, strengthen collaboration across functions, develop talent and succession depth, and ensure the Leadership Team operates as one enterprise team.
Preserve organizational knowledge and key relationships while enabling change; provide candid counsel and continuity for the CEO without creating an alternate center of authority.
Support the Board and Executive Chair with accurate operating context, follow-through, and governance-aligned communication; help maintain clear decision rights and organizational alignment.
Advance growth initiatives, acquisitions, partnerships, and integration work by connecting strategy, market opportunity, operating capacity, technology, and execution.

Direct Reports

Executive Vice President
Vice President of IT
Director of Operations
Executive Director of State Offices
General Manager, Results Coaching Global
Executive Assistant

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will bring significant senior operating leadership in a multifaceted organization, sound financial and business judgment, and a record of leading through influence. The role requires exceptional communication, discretion, relationship-building, decision-making, and follow-through; the ability to balance continuity with change; and comfort working across commercial, mission, technology, talent, and governance priorities. Experience in K-12 education, professional services, publishing, events, educational technology, or a comparable knowledge-based enterprise is strongly preferred.

About Solution Tree

Solution Tree is a leading K-12 professional learning and educational publishing organization whose mission is to advance the work of our authors.

jobs.title: Director of Advancement
jobs.description:
Description

Connecticut Institute For Communities, Inc. (CIFC) seeks full-time Director of Advancement. The Director of Advancement is a senior leadership position responsible for developing, implementing, and managing a comprehensive resource development and community engagement strategy that advances the mission of Connecticut Institute For Communities, Inc. (CIFC). The Director leads all philanthropic, fundraising, donor stewardship, corporate sponsorship, foundation relations, and advancement activities supporting CIFC’s Federally Qualified Health Center, Education and Housing initiatives and other mission-driven services.

Working collaboratively with executive leadership, Board members, program leaders, and community partners, the Director of Advancement will cultivate diverse funding sources, strengthen community relationships, increase philanthropic support, and enhance CIFC's visibility throughout the communities it serves.

Requirements

Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Nonprofit Management, Business Administration, Public Administration, Communications, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or related field required.

Experience: three to five (3 - 5) or more years of progressive experience in fundraising, development, advancement, philanthropy, nonprofit management, or related field. Demonstrated success securing major gifts, foundation grants, corporate sponsorships, and individual donor support. Experience developing and implementing comprehensive fundraising strategies. Experience working within healthcare, community health centers, human services, education, early childhood programs, or nonprofit organizations preferred. Experience supporting Board development and volunteer engagement activities preferred.

Competitive compensation commensurate on experience. Comprehensive fringe benefits package including health care and ancillary coverages and retirement program. CIFC a PSLF approved site. 13-paid holidays and generous paid time-off. Mission-focused environment.

jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.description:
About WovenX Health, Inc.

WovenX Health is building a new model for specialty care, starting in Gastroenterology. We combine virtual care, clinical navigation, and artificial intelligence to help patients access high-quality care faster while supporting health systems and physician practices across the country. As we continue to scale nationally, we're looking for leaders who enjoy building intelligent systems, solving complex operational problems, and creating world-class clinical infrastructure that enables growth.

About The Role

We're looking for a Director of Operations to lead the operational infrastructure behind WovenX's national clinical network. You'll oversee the business operations behind our clinical platform that connects virtual care with physician practices, endoscopy centers, and health systems across 50 states + DC. Working closely with Clinical, Product, Engineering, and Growth, you are responsible for improving the workflows, analytics, processes, and systems that allow high-quality specialty care to scale in real-time.

What You'll Own

Build scalable operational processes that connect virtual care with brick-and-mortar physician practices and health system partners. This includes but is not limited to building tools, applications, and complex constraint models that are able to account for a number of variables: reporting, operational, analytical, legal, clinical, and staffing
Lead day-to-day operations for WovenX's virtual care and clinical navigation programs, which include primary responsibility for our virtual visit infrastructure and real-time staffing across sites, states, and clinicians. Think of this as the lead of driver engagement and markets at Lyft or Uber - the product manager and director of our WovenX care delivery systems
Build dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that drive operational decision-making and tooling.
Define processes that support our clinical team onboarding, credentialing, scheduling, and operational readiness for day-to-day and new market launches.
Monitor clinical quality, regulatory compliance, and operational performance jointly with our clinical team.

What You'll Bring

A desire to drive our team and business forward and have a meaningful impact. We are looking for someone with a strong work ethic, an appetite for startup culture, and excitement about transforming how healthcare works.
Experience working with a distributed network of advanced practice providers and / or physicians.
Experience launching new markets, standing up complex operations, and scaling care delivery. Ideally looking for experience across multiple states’ and legislative settings in healthcare.
A strong operational mindset with the ability to build processes, measure performance, and continuously improve quality.
Comfort partnering with Product and Engineering to translate clinical workflows and operational reporting into scalable technology.
Ideally looking for candidates who have built internal applications and analytics tools, or directly managed data and performance tracking. Experience using workflow automation, AI-enabled tools, and operational data to improve clinical quality, efficiency, and provider experience.
Excellent judgment, communication, and relationship-building skills across clinical, operational, and commercial teams.
A builder's mentality - you enjoy creating systems that scale rather than maintaining legacy processes, with demonstrated success creating operational systems.

Your Skills And Credentials

5+ years of experience leading operations in healthcare, virtual care, or a high-growth healthcare services organization. Ideally looking for someone who has worked in healthcare operations at an AI-led or big tech company.
Masters in Operations, Statistics, Analytics, Business Administration, or similar field is a plus but not required (we are most focused on your real experience building in operations and clinical environments)
Product managers (technical or core PM), former consultants, and operational leads with analytical and P&L responsibility most welcome.
Past startup experience preferred.
Comfort with analytical or technical platforms, enough to build models in excel, python, AWS, SQL, or similar platforms and structures that enable you to track performance, interpret data, and launch tooling and systems together with our engineering team.
Rigorous attention to detail.
Comfort with AI tools and workflows.

Why WovenX

This is an opportunity to help build one of the country's leading specialty care networks. You'll have meaningful ownership, work alongside experienced clinical and technology leaders, and help shape the operational platform that connects virtual care with specialty practices at national scale. We believe human-centered and AI-driven care is one of the core ways we make specialty healthcare more accessible.

Our team is looking for the brightest minds in healthcare tech who are committed to building something big and meaningful.

WovenX Health is an equal opportunity employer.

Compensation, Perks, Benefits, Logistics

Total Compensation: $150,000 - 170,000 base salary range + employee equity package
Comprehensive Care: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage packages.
Support Frameworks: 401(k) plan option, flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), and a hybrid work environment connected with Chicago’s best Healthcare co-working space.
Location: this is a hybrid role. Our ideal candidate is located (or willing to relocate) to Chicago, IL and will be in office flexibly with our Chicago team ~3 days / week. For exceptional candidates, we will consider a remote application. Collaboration, dependability, and engagement are a core part of our distributed and hybrid work environments.

At this time, WovenX is unable to provide visa sponsorship. All Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship needs.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

150,000 - 170,000 USD per year(Merchandise Mart, Chicago)
